1.web: Hear us, Shepherd of Israel, you who lead Joseph like a flock, you who sit above the cherubim, shine out.
1.asv: Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, Thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; Thou that sittest above the cherubim, shine forth.

2.web: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up your might! Come to save us!
2.asv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh, stir up thy might, And come to save us.

3.web: Turn us again, God. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
3.asv: Turn us again, O God; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

4.web: Yahweh God of Armies, How long will you be angry against the prayer of your people?
4.asv: O Jehovah God of hosts, How long wilt thou be angry against the prayer of thy people?

5.web: You have fed them with the bread of tears, and given them tears to drink in large measure.
5.asv: Thou hast fed them with the bread of tears, And given them tears to drink in large measure.

6.web: You make us a source of contention to our neighbors. Our enemies laugh among themselves.
6.asv: Thou makest us a strife unto our neighbors; And our enemies laugh among themselves.

7.web: Turn us again, God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
7.asv: Turn us again, O God of hosts; And cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.

8.web: You brought a vine out of Egypt. You drove out the nations, and planted it.
8.asv: Thou broughtest a vine out of Egypt: Thou didst drive out the nations, and plantedst it.

9.web: You cleared the ground for it. It took deep root, and filled the land.
9.asv: Thou preparedst room before it, And it took deep root, and filled the land.

10.web: The mountains were covered with its shadow. Its boughs were like God’s cedars.
10.asv: The mountains were covered with the shadow of it, And the boughs thereof were like cedars of God.

11.web: It sent out its branches to the sea, Its shoots to the River.
11.asv: It sent out its branches unto the sea, And its shoots unto the River.

12.web: Why have you broken down its walls, so that all those who pass by the way pluck it?
12.asv: Why hast thou broken down its walls, So that all they that pass by the way do pluck it?

13.web: The boar out of the wood ravages it. The wild animals of the field feed on it.
13.asv: The boar out of the wood doth ravage it, And the wild beasts of the field feed on it.

14.web: Turn again, we beg you, God of Armies. Look down from heaven, and see, and visit this vine,
14.asv: Turn again, we beseech thee, O God of hosts: Look down from heaven, and behold, and visit this vine,

15.web: the stock which your right hand planted, the branch that you made strong for yourself.
15.asv: And the stock which thy right hand planted, And the branch that thou madest strong for thyself.

16.web: It’s burned with fire. It’s cut down. They perish at your rebuke.
16.asv: It is burned with fire, it is cut down: They perish at the rebuke of thy countenance.

17.web: Let your hand be on the man of your right hand, on the son of man whom you made strong for yourself.
17.asv: Let thy hand be upon the man of thy right hand, Upon the son of man whom thou madest strong for thyself.

18.web: So we will not turn away from you. Revive us, and we will call on your name.
18.asv: So shall we not go back from thee: Quicken thou us, and we will call upon thy name.

19.web: Turn us again, Yahweh God of Armies. Cause your face to shine, and we will be saved.
19.asv: Turn us again, O Jehovah God of hosts; Cause thy face to shine, and we shall be saved.
